response.sql: WITH u AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) AS cnt FROM scanfeatures GROUP BY zoneref), t AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS total FROM scanfeatures), s AS (SELECT u.zoneref, u.cnt, CAST(u.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM u CROSS JOIN t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, s.cnt AS artifact_count, s.share AS share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (s.share - a.avg_share) IS NULL, s.share - a.avg_share DESC, s.zoneref LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A site whose artifact counts are all missing is still kept as a unit with a NULL count and NULL share. It is excluded from the average and sorted last.
If the overall total is 0, the shares are NULL (SQLite division by zero), so the average is NULL and no rows are returned.
Ties in the difference are broken by site code, which the request does not specify.
